name: act
description: Submit your one action for this decision. Call exactly once per reply.

action.description: A UCI move (e2e4, e7e8q), optionally followed by ' claim'; or claim_draw, resign, offer_draw, accept_draw.

talk.description: Optional public table talk, at most 140 characters. Shown to your opponent after your action.

memo.description: Optional private note to yourself, at most 280 characters. Shown only to you at your next decision.
